record.question: Which of the following is not the fundamental principles of NEP 2020?
options: Extensive use of technology in teaching and learning
record.explanation: In NEP 2020’s specific list headed fundamental principles, multidisciplinary/holistic education, rootedness/pride in India and extensive technology use are listed. Internationalization is discussed elsewhere in the policy (not absent from NEP altogether), but is not a separate item in that introductory list. Reference: https://www.education.gov.in/sites/upload_files/mhrd/files/NEP_Final_English_0.pdf; https://www.education.gov.in/nep/internationalisation-education. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
